browser: Google Chrome (Playwright over CDP, headed), 1440×900; mobile check 390×844
verdict:
Not ready for release. The core inquiry flow works end-to-end in every booking module (Local, Outstation, Transfer P2P / Return / By Hour, Multi-Leg): search → results → Fare Breakup → review, with the fare arithmetic (components = grand total) consistent in every completed check; one fare boundary rule failed (extra hours, DEF-01). Release is blocked by 6 high-severity defects: extra hours not charged in Local estimates, Outstation final drop ignoring the pickup, SUV unbookable (0 seats), Transfer passengers capped at 20, eight blank footer pages and a non-functional Fleet Finder.

The final submissions (Confirm & Submit, Save As Draft, tickets, profile save, logout) were not executed: they need explicit approval. Eight cases are Blocked pending a re-run after automation fixes made during this run.
coverage:
• Modules: 12 explored and tested (site navigation & content, authentication & profile, Local, Outstation, Transfer P2P, P2P + Return, By Hour, Multi-Leg, results & vehicle details, fleet, customer support, services/about).
  • Trip configurations: Local CFG-1…CFG-4; Outstation 1/3/5 destinations with default and different drop, interstate, same-day; Transfer within-city, outside-city, interstate, airport, return; By Hour 1 and 24 hrs, different drop, multi-day; Multi-Leg Local+Outstation and Local+Transfer.
  • Data: rows from all 6 workbook sheets; present and future dates; hours 0/1/8/10/24/25; passengers 1–60 incl. 49 and above-capacity; 20 vehicle types (ADDITIONAL_TEST_INFO).
  • Edge and negative: blank mandatory fields, past date/time, drop before pickup, same From/To, toggle transitions, out-of-city pickup, refresh/back, direct URL, logged-out access, malformed login input, mobile viewport.
  • Not covered: final submission of inquiries, drafts and tickets (approval), payments, cancellation, logout, OTP/registration, cross-browser (Chrome only).
questions:
• Local: is billing the 8Hr/80Km package for shorter requests intended, and how should extra hours and extra km appear in the estimate (DEF-01)?
  • Outstation: with Different Drop OFF, should the trip end at the pickup (test data) or at the last destination (current behaviour)?
  • GST ('Additional') and Toll/Parking ('Actuals') never appear in the estimate. Confirm this is intended.
  • Should Local trips with far-away drops (e.g. Mangaluru) be allowed, or be redirected to Outstation?
  • Transfer passenger limit: 20 or 49?
  • By Hour costs ₹8,000 (Transfer < 30 KM package) vs Local ₹4,500 for the same 4-hour Sedan input. Confirm the intended pricing difference.
